d: We are currently seeking passionate and dynamic Finance professionals who pride themselves on their ability to deliver extraordinary levels of customer service and provide creative solutions to our guests.
As an Accounts Supervisor Receivable you are responsible to review the city ledger, prepare invoices and verify purchase slips in a smooth and effective way and in compliance with all policies.
q: You should have a degree in hotel management or accounting and at least one year previous experience within a hotel environment. Excellent verbal and written English communication skills and computer literacy are required, while knowledge of Opera, Micros, FBM and SUN systems is an asset.
The ideal candidate will be results-oriented and self-motivated along with a positive attitude.
You have the ability to think laterally and analytically, display a high level of integrity and have the ability to identify, impact and influence others.
You are a strong team player, enthusiastic and flexible, while possessing the following additional competencies
r: Transfer daily city ledger data from Front Office system to Back Office Accounts Receivable module
Verify the total transfer with city ledger folios
Review the city ledger folios with supporting documents such as charge slips, LPOs, etc.
Follow up if required for billing instructions, LPOs, supporting documents, etc.
Prepare invoices and obtain Director of Finance Financial Controller signature
Send the original invoices with supporting documents to the customer, file a copy of the full set in the customer file and another copy in the sequential file
Calculate commission for credit card payments received
Issue receipts for cash and cheques received from customers and credit card payment received directly to the bank
Hand over all cash receipts to the General Cashier with receipt copy
Prepare and give employee city ledger summary to the Paymaster on the 25th of each month

d: Calo is an app providing personalized meal plans for busy people through nutritional algorithms, built with love by chefs, nutritionists, and software engineers.

Launched in Bahrain in 2019, we have since expanded to 6 countries, delivered millions of meals to our customers, and are now expanding our mission of making healthy easy to retail and other verticals.
We're on a noble mission to make healthy easy. We think this is one of the most important problems to tackle in our world today. We have global ambitions - no small thinking here.
As Commercial Director (Demand & Growth), you will be responsible for driving demand generation, customer growth, revenue performance, and market expansion across Saudi Arabia.
You will lead the development and execution of market growth strategies while identifying new opportunities across subscriptions, partnerships, retail, CPG, and emerging business initiatives.
This is not a traditional brand marketing role.

We're looking for a business leader whose core expertise is marketing and growth, but who approaches every decision through a commercial lens. You'll be expected to own outcomes, make independent decisions, and act as a strategic partner to market leadership.
Success in this role will be measured by your ability to grow customers, improve retention, increase revenue, unlock new growth opportunities, and drive overall market performance.
q: 8+ years of experience in Growth, Commercial Marketing, Demand Generation, Revenue Growth, Market Expansion, or related leadership roles
Experience scaling consumer-facing businesses in high-growth environments
Proven track record of driving measurable customer growth, retention, and revenue impact
Experience owning market performance, business growth, or commercial outcomes beyond traditional marketing metrics
Experience operating within the Saudi market is highly preferred
Deep understanding of customer growth, retention, subscriptions, revenue drivers, and commercial performance
Strong business acumen with the ability to identify growth opportunities beyond marketing campaigns
Experience launching new channels, products, partnerships, or business initiatives
Ability to operate independently and make high-quality decisions with limited oversight
Strong analytical mindset with exceptional problem-solving skills
Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership abilities
Strong understanding of Saudi consumer behavior, competitive dynamics, and growth opportunities
Existing network within the Saudi business ecosystem is a plus
Comfortable with ambiguity and scaling challenges
Someone who naturally thinks like a General Manager, not just a marketer
We’re not looking for cookie-cutter applications. Surprise us.

Show us your creativity, your drive, and who you are beyond a CV. Send a Loom, a Notion page, a deck, a video, a voice note, whatever feels most “you.” Tell us why you belong here at Calo and why this role excites you.
r: Lead market growth strategy across Saudi Arabia
Drive customer acquisition, retention, engagement, and revenue growth
Own demand generation and customer growth performance across all channels
Identify growth opportunities and prioritize initiatives with the highest commercial impact
Act as a key business partner in driving overall market performance
Launch and scale new growth channels, partnerships, and business opportunities
Support expansion initiatives across subscriptions, retail, CPG, and future business verticals
Identify and execute strategic partnerships that drive customer and revenue growth
Evaluate pricing, promotions, offers, and commercial initiatives to maximize business performance
Develop integrated growth strategies across digital, offline, CRM, lifecycle, referral, and performance marketing channels
Optimize marketing investments through rigorous performance analysis and ROI management
Continuously improve CAC efficiency, retention, LTV, and revenue contribution
Ensure marketing efforts directly support business growth objectives
Serve as Calo's commercial owner for Saudi Arabia
Build relationships with partners, agencies, vendors, and key stakeholders across the Kingdom
Represent the business locally and provide market intelligence, customer insights, and competitive analysis
Act with a high degree of ownership and autonomy in market decision-making
Analyze customer behavior, growth trends, market opportunities, and competitive dynamics
Build reporting frameworks and performance dashboards that connect marketing efforts to business outcomes
Use insights to inform strategic decisions and resource allocation
Actively utilize AI tools to improve analysis, planning, execution, content creation, productivity, and decision-making
Champion innovative growth practices and scalable operating models
Continuously explore new technologies and automation opportunities that improve team effectiveness and business performance
Partner closely with Commercial, Product, Growth, Operations, Finance, and Leadership teams
Align growth initiatives with broader company objectives
Lead agencies, external partners, and cross-functional projects from strategy through execution

d: Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.

QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.

QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard & Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3) and Fitch (A+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.

Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.

The incumbent will manage the entire research, analysis, market intelligence, co-ordination and finalisation of QNB economic reports, along with other monthly deliverables and other ad hoc requests. He will also facilitate the monitoring and reporting of economic developments in key international markets, competitive information, and strategic opportunities.
q: Bachelor Degree in Finance, Economics, Market Research, or equivalent.
Master degree and Ph.D. in Economics from a top global university is an advantage.
At least 10 years of work experience within the economic department of a global financial institution with proven managerial oversight of small teams, with at least five years as an economist.
Experience in writing Macro Economic and Research reports.
r: Manage the appropriate use of tools, data, statistical packages, and other research subscriptions necessary for the workflow of Group Economics.
Manage the preparation of input for business and budget forecasts (economic reports and macroeconomic forecasts across countries).
Implements KPI’s and best practices for Assistant Vice President Economic role.
Promote cost consciousness and efficiency and enhance productivity, to minimise cost, avoid waste, and optimise benefits for the bank.
Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent.
Manage research products and investor relations activities associated with macroeconomics.

Manage all Group Economics publications and thought leadership activities, such as Country Economic Insight Reports, Weekly Economic Commentary, Qatar Monthly Monitor, Global Macro Updates, and ad-hoc bespoke reports.

Manage all day-to-day business activities, including the economic sections for the Investment Management Committee (IMC), Asset and Liability Management Committee (ALCO), Group Management Risk Committee (GMRC), and Ratings Report.
Maintain activities in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/units to achieve improvements in turn-around time.
Support recruitment efforts, providing motivation and reinforcing high standards of performance, as well as adherence to the Bank’s values and mission.
Engage and provide coaching to managers and associates in all aspects of the generation of internal and external reports.
Proactively identify areas for professional development of self and undertake development activities.
Seek out opportunities to remain current with all developments in professional field.

d: The Senior Accountant will serve as the standalone financial engine for a high-volume trading operation, taking full ownership of the end-to-end accounting cycle. This role demands a hands-on financial professional capable of managing dense transactional throughput across Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and the General Ledger (GL), while simultaneously producing accurate, executive-grade financial statements, Balance Sheets, and MIS reports to guide management decision-making.
Prepare accurate and timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, including Profit & Loss (P&L) and Balance Sheets.
Design and generate detailed Management Information System (MIS) reports, offering insights into trade margins, operational expenditures, and revenue trends.
Develop and maintain daily/weekly cash flow forecasts to ensure adequate liquidity for high-volume trading activities.
Perform variance analysis against budgets, providing commentary on discrepancies to senior management.
Maintain the General Ledger, ensuring all financial transactions are recorded accurately and in compliance with international accounting standards (IFRS/GAAP).
Execute rigorous month-end and year-end closing procedures within strict deadlines.
Conduct complex monthly bank reconciliations, inventory reconciliations, and intercompany reconciliations.
Oversee fixed asset accounting and depreciation schedules.
Process a high volume of vendor invoices, verifying documentation, purchase orders, and approvals prior to payment processing.
Manage supplier relationships, reconcile vendor statements, and execute weekly/monthly payment runs to optimize cash retention.
Oversee the complete AR lifecycle, including raising high-volume commercial invoices, tracking incoming payments, and enforcing rigorous credit control and collection protocols.
Resolve any billing discrepancies or trade-related disputes promptly to prevent cash flow bottlenecks.
Prepare and file regional tax returns (e.g., VAT, Corporate Tax) accurately and on time, ensuring full multi-jurisdictional compliance where applicable.
Implement and enforce internal financial controls, standardizing operating procedures to mitigate financial risk.
Act as the primary point of contact for external auditors, preparing all required schedules and documentation for annual audits.
